title: Jurassic climate mode governed by ocean gateway
subject: Ecology
question: What is the approximate minimum δ¹⁸O_carb value recorded during the Toarcian Oceanic Anoxic Event (OAE), and what is the corresponding inferred palaeotemperature?

gold_answer.short_answer: The minimum δ¹⁸O_carb is approximately -5.8‰ PDB, which corresponds to an inferred palaeotemperature of about 34°C.
gold_answer.long_answer: The chart displays a significant negative excursion in the oxygen-isotope ratio (δ¹⁸O_carb) during the Toarcian Oceanic Anoxic Event (OAE), which begins around biosubzone no. 44. The lowest data point within this event, a grey triangle, reaches a minimum δ¹⁸O_carb value of approximately -5.8‰ PDB. According to the right y-axis, this δ¹⁸O value corresponds to a maximum inferred palaeotemperature of about 34°C.
